name: Rain of Frogs — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Rain of Frogs from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Rain of Frogs" but are not part of the Rain of Frogs entry, which is unchanged.

hp 31 (9d8–9)
Fort +5, Ref +7, Will +3
Defensive Abilities swarm traits, Immune weapon damage

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., climb 30 ft.
Melee swarm (2d6 plus poison [1d4 Con damage; Fort DC 13])
Space 10 ft.; Reach 0 ft.

*Special Notes on the Stat Block: If this were truly an “animal” instead of vermin (as centipede would be) there would be many other changes to make as well. However, the spell simply says to use the centipede swarm with the following changes…” so only the changes indicated in the spell have been applied.
